title: Empty list and filtered-result composition
guidance: Align the no-active-jobs board icon beside the heading. Empty and no-match states use concise text and relevant actions, with no redundant pagination or large arbitrary blank area.

decisions.title: Icon and heading share one lead-in
decisions.reason: The board icon sits beside No active jobs; explanatory copy and the relevant reset/action follow with deliberate spacing.

decisions.title: Filtered absence is concise
decisions.reason: No rating matches uses a short heading and Show all ratings. A single-page result has no pager.

parameters.name: Empty hierarchy
parameters.description: Heading and icon form one intrinsic row. Body explains a meaningful next step; it does not repeat obvious context. Enlarged text can use the full available width.

status.human: manual guidance received; revision awaits human review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment
